author: ZimaOS Team
description: Bringing all of your home videos, music, and photos together into one place has never been easier. Your personal Emby Server automatically converts and streams your media on-the-fly to play on any device.
tagline: TAKE YOUR MEDIA ANYWHERE WITH EMBY
title: Emby(Nvidia GPU)
release_note:
- Update to Emby Server 4.10.2.0 stable.
- Improve search performance and fix Spotlight issues on older devices.
- Fix playback from the Albums tab and subtitle-off settings not being remembered.
- Add an option to disable folder outlines and improve the Live TV tuner detection dialog.
